description: Key prefixes approved for publication to the public R2 bucket (boundaries-data, served at https://data.civgraph.net). Writing an object under one of these prefixes publishes it to the open internet immediately. scripts/lib/r2-publication-gate.mjs refuses uploads to any key not covered here.
howToAddAPrefix: Add an entry with prefix, rationale, and evidence, then have it reviewed in the same commit as the upload that needs it. Do not add a prefix speculatively.
seedNote: Seeded 2026-08-05 from prefixes ALREADY serving publicly. These entries record observed production state; they are not a retrospective grant of approval. Rights reviewed 2026-08-05: every census prefix is Crown copyright under Open Government Licence v3.0 per the agent/ READMEs cited below, corroborated by the 'censusNisraOgl' rights code already used in approved-publication-sources.json.

prefixes.rationale: Canonical store for boundary geometry (FGB + compression variants) and per-map JSON indexes. The repo deliberately does not track these.
prefixes.evidence: .gitignore:158 'All FGBs in data/maps/ - R2 (data.civgraph.net) is the canonical source'; functions/data/maps/[[path]].js serves this prefix; verified live 2026-08-05 via preflight-data-migration.mjs
prefixes.rights: per-source; recorded on the individual Browse source records

prefixes.rationale: Feature thumbnail images served on Browse cards. Published by the existing sync:thumbnails npm script.
prefixes.evidence: package.json sync:thumbnails runs upload-tile-pyramid-s3.mjs against this prefix; also scripts/upload-feature-thumbnails-r2.mjs and the deploy:feature-thumbnails:r2 script
prefixes.rights: derived renderings of the underlying map sources; inherit their per-source terms

prefixes.rationale: Tailte Eireann National Land Cover 2018, CC BY 4.0 (verified from the ArcGIS item licenseInfo; data.gov.ie records no licence at all). Mirrored because the 48.5 GB GeoPackage could not complete an Internet Archive upload -- a single 5.5-hour stream was reset with nothing to resume. R2 multipart is resumable.
prefixes.evidence: archive.org/details/civgraph-tailte-national-land-cover-2018 holds the FileGDB original; this is the GeoPackage form of the same layer (NATIONAL_LAND_COVER_MAP_ITM, 10,114,816 features, EPSG:2157, verified identical with ogrinfo).

prefixes.rationale: Houses of the Oireachtas full text: 26,415 Akoma Ntoso debate transcripts and 13,918 bill/act PDFs, harvested from data.oireachtas.ie. Open data. Mirrored because the tree is currently single-copy on an exFAT volume with no journaling, and because the API only ever returns pointers to these documents.
prefixes.evidence: scripts/harvest-oireachtas-fulltext.mjs; completeness proven from disk (advertised 13,919 bill documents, 13,918 held -- the one exception, Maternity Protection (Amendment) Bill 2003 ver_b, is zero bytes at source with Content-Length: 0).

prefixes.rationale: The bulk downloads written by npm run records:downloads: the records database (civgraph-records-<version>.sqlite.gz and -latest), the graph exports (civgraph.jsonld, civgraph-rdf.ndjson, civgraph-provenance.json, gzipped) and civgraph-graph-shards.tar.gz (the graph shard files byte for byte), with manifest.json. They replaced the R2 data/graph/exports and statement-shards copies on 9 Nov 2026 (owner-approved).
prefixes.evidence: packages/loader/src/downloads.mjs writes them; functions/data/graph/[[path]].js 301s the old bulk URLs here; every record in them is already served publicly by /_api and /api/v1.
prefixes.rights: Derived work. Carries no source data of its own -- it is an index over records whose terms are recorded per source in data/database/maps.json and sources.json, and it inherits those terms.

prefixes.rationale: Scanned Dublin City Council development-plan sheets (1991 and 1993) and two page extracts, cited as primary evidence by the dublin-electoral-counties-1985 layer. This entry documents an EXISTING publication rather than authorising a new one: all 12 objects are already in the bucket, and every reference to them in the catalogue is an absolute https://data.civgraph.net/ URL, so R2 is already the address the site hands out.
prefixes.evidence: All 12 files verified present on data.civgraph.net with byte-exact Content-Length against the local copies (2026-08-12). 64 references across data/database/maps.json, render/metadata/maps-test.json, data/browse/maps.json and data/browse/details/source-shards/sources-183.json -- all 64 absolute to data.civgraph.net, zero relative. No Function is needed for this prefix.
prefixes.rights: Dublin City Council development plan material, cited as source evidence for a published boundary layer; terms recorded against the layer in data/database/maps.json.

prefixes.rationale: Per-map feature attribute pages (data/browse/map-features/<id>/...), fetched directly from data.civgraph.net by browse/browse.js (MAP_FEATURES_BASE). Generated, never tracked. The rest of data/browse/ (the old Browse index files) retired on 8 Nov 2026 (owner): those URLs answer from D1 or 410 in functions/data/browse/[[path]].js, and the R2 copies were deleted. Browse indexes and per-record detail pages: the data behind browse/browse.js. Not excluded by .cfignore, so Cloudflare Pages already serves this entire tree publicly at civgraph.net/data/browse/ -- moving it to R2 changes the host, not the exposure. Mostly build output of scripts/build-browse-indexes.mjs; see the evidence note for the one file that is not. Subsumes the former data/browse/map-features/ entry: per-map feature attribute pages, generated and never tracked, already fetched directly from R2 by browse/browse.js.
prefixes.evidence: civgraph.net/data/browse/index.json, persons.json and source-index-shards/sources-000.json all return 200 from Pages today. 2,386 files / 351 MB tracked. Regeneration test on 2026-08-12 (directory moved aside, builder re-run from clean): 2,278 of 2,386 files reproduced. The 107 map details not reproduced are stale -- 98 are hidden:true in the catalogue and correctly excluded, 9 are the retired eds-YYYY-province naming set. proni-roots.json (1.39 MB) is the exception: NOTHING in scripts/ generates it, browse/browse.js fetches it with a silent .catch(() => null), so it is source material and must not be treated as regenerable. Former map-features evidence retained: browse/browse.js:169 MAP_FEATURES_BASE = https://data.civgraph.net/data/browse/map-features; .gitignore excludes data/browse/map-features/, so that subtree is generated-only and was never in git.
prefixes.rights: Derived indexes over records already published on the site. Carries no source data of its own; per-source terms are recorded in data/database/maps.json and sources.json and are inherited.

prefixes.rationale: Census sources, cleaned derivatives and OCR text for the all-Ireland census series. Approved for publication by the site owner on 2026-08-12. Subsumes the previously separate entries for data/census/2001-bulk/, data/census/2001-cleaned/, data/census/2011-bulk/, data/census/2011-cleaned/, data/census/nisra-ftb/, which were narrower prefixes of this same tree.
prefixes.evidence: Provenance is CSO/NISRA plus Internet Archive mirrors, harvested by scripts/census/scrape-cso-historical-reports.mjs and scripts/census/recover-cso-failed-links-wayback.mjs, with data/census/source-inventory/cso-historical-reports-ia-manifest.json and census-source-archives.json recording the mirrors. 4,980 files / 317 MB tracked.
prefixes.rights: Irish and Northern Irish official statistics. CSO material is published under CC BY 4.0; NISRA material under OGL. Derived and OCR products inherit those terms.

prefixes.rationale: Full territorial-transition sidecars for the ward chain -- the source QA artefacts the runtime overlays in data/timeline-transition-overlays/ are filtered from. Approved for publication 2026-08-12.
prefixes.evidence: Generated by scripts/build_all_timeline_transition_sidecars.py from data/maps, so wholly derived from boundary geometry already published on the site. 6 files / 153 MB tracked (4 geojson plus manifest and README); the rest of the directory has been gitignored since data/timeline-transitions/*.geojson was added to .gitignore.
prefixes.rights: Derived work over the site's own boundary layers; inherits their per-source terms as recorded in data/database/maps.json.

prefixes.rationale: Transcribed and scanned source books: 49 Northern Ireland Hansard volumes (House of Commons and Senate, 1921-1945) as OCR markdown, 13 NI Acts and Statutory Rules and Orders PDFs (1921-1932), and the boundary reports. Moving them to R2 takes 365 MB out of the Pages deploy and out of the git pack, where they are the largest churning blobs.
prefixes.evidence: Measured 2026-08-23: data/books/markdown is 213 MB and data/books/legislation 152 MB, both served 200 from civgraph.net and 404 from data.civgraph.net, so they ship through Pages today. data/database/books.json lists 67 entries. Requested explicitly by the project owner.
prefixes.rights: ALREADY PUBLIC on civgraph.net, so this republishes nothing new. Underlying rights remain UNRESOLVED and this prefix does not settle them: NI Hansard and NI Acts are Crown copyright, and 33 of the tracked markdown files carry University of California library markings (UC-NRLF) identifying the scans they were transcribed from. Recording per-item source and licence in books.json is tracked separately as the books-provenance task.

prefixes.rationale: The complete CSO PxStat statistical corpus as JSON-stat: 12,528 cubes plus their release metadata, 7.9 GB. Civgraph holds a mirrored source portal for Northern Ireland (data/nisra-files/, data/nisra-portal/) but nothing equivalent for the Republic, where only boundary geometry was held and the statistics attached to it were links to cso.ie. This closes that asymmetry with the one southern corpus that carries a single, uniform, already-determined licence.
prefixes.evidence: Mirrored by scripts/scrape_cso_pxstat.py via the public PxStat RESTful API; measured 2026-08-31 at 12,529 files / 7.9 GB against a catalogue of 12,528 matrices, i.e. complete. Every matrix now carries an approved-publication record: 12,314 from the earlier CSO tranches (censusCategory1, censusCsoNiCarveout, csoPxstatBacklog) and the last 214 from cat1-cso-pxstat-completion, emitted by scripts/cso-emit-pxstat-gap-records.mjs and asserted in validate-approved-publication-path.mjs.
prefixes.rights: CC BY 4.0, uniform across the collection. Not a new determination: CSO PxStat rights were confirmed clear in this repo on 2026-07-07 and are already relied on by the 12,314 gated cubes -- see scripts/census-emit-cso-carveout-records.mjs. Attribution is carried on every record: 'Contains Irish Public Sector Data licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence.' Per-cube metadata carries extension.copyright naming the CSO but no per-cube licence, so the basis is the collection licence, which is why it applies uniformly.

prefixes.rationale: NISRA source mirror: 33,593 objects, 7.52 GB. The northern counterpart to data/cso-pxstat/ -- the statistical source material behind the census and Browse records, held locally rather than linked, so the records survive NISRA reorganising its site.
prefixes.evidence: Measured 2026-08-31 against boundaries-data: 33,593 objects / 7.52 GB, publicly readable. Uploaded before the publication gate existed and never allowlisted; recorded here as observed production state. Referenced by scripts/census/{mirror-nisra-files-to-ia,plan-nisra-ia-mirror,reenrich-nisra-with-ia}.mjs.
prefixes.rights: Crown copyright under Open Government Licence v3.0. Not a new determination: 4,044 approved-publication records already credit NISRA under OGL v3.0, and the censusNisraOgl tranche (645 records) rests on the same basis. This extends that licence from the catalogue records to the mirrored source files they describe -- an inference, but the same material under the same licence.

prefixes.rationale: Cleaned NISRA portal tables as gzipped CSV: 1,115 objects, 48 MB. Normalised extracts of the data.nisra.gov.uk cubes, kept so the cleaned form is reproducible without re-crawling the portal.
prefixes.evidence: Measured 2026-08-31: 1,115 objects / 0.05 GB, publicly readable. No code outside the allowlist references the prefix; it is a data asset, not a served route. Uploaded before the gate existed.
prefixes.rights: Crown copyright under Open Government Licence v3.0, same basis as data/nisra-files/. Cleaning and gzipping do not change the licence; OGL v3.0 permits adaptation with attribution.

prefixes.rationale: NI Multiple Deprivation Measure source spreadsheets, 2001 and 2005: 6 objects, 7 MB. The originals behind the deprivation records, kept because the 2001 and 2005 releases are no longer straightforward to obtain from NISRA.
prefixes.evidence: Measured 2026-08-31: 6 objects / 0.007 GB, publicly readable, keys under data/deprivation/nimdm/{2001,2005}/originals/. Smallest prefix in the bucket.
prefixes.rights: Crown copyright under Open Government Licence v3.0. NIMDM is a NISRA publication and falls under the same OGL basis as data/nisra-files/.

prefixes.rationale: Point clouds converted to 3D Tiles for the map viewer: 393,355 objects, 32.95 GB across the A26 corridor and Newry. The largest thing in the bucket. Served directly to the browser by the deck.gl Tile3DLayer, so the tiles must be publicly fetchable for the viewer to work at all.
prefixes.evidence: Measured 2026-08-31: 393,355 objects / 32.95 GB. Referenced by src/ui-controller.js and the built app chunk, i.e. this prefix is load-bearing for a live site feature. 347 approved-publication records match, carrying OGL v3.0 and CC BY 4.0.
prefixes.rights: Derived works from OpenDataNI lidar releases, which are Crown copyright under Open Government Licence v3.0. OGL v3.0 expressly permits adapting the Information and publishing the adaptation with attribution, which is what the LAS-to-3D-Tiles conversion is. Note this IS a derivative-rights judgement rather than a lookup: the licence on the source release is being read as covering Civgraph's converted tiles.

prefixes.rationale: Rendered per-feature PNG thumbnails: 47,521 objects, 204 MB. Generated by Civgraph from its own map layers for Browse feature cards.
prefixes.evidence: Measured 2026-08-31: 47,521 objects / 0.20 GB. Referenced by scripts/render-feature-thumbnails.mjs, scripts/upload-feature-thumbnails-r2.mjs and data/database/feature-thumbnails/{rendered-assets,_manifest}.json. NOTE: the allowlist already carries assets/thumbnails/, which is NOT the prefix the uploader writes to -- upload-feature-thumbnails-r2.mjs defaults to data/thumbnails/features and package.json passes --skip-check, which is how these reached the bucket ungated. See docs/r2-prefix-reconciliation.md.
prefixes.rights: Renders Civgraph produced from map layers it already publishes; rights follow the source maps rather than existing independently. Same position data/maps/ takes: per-source, recorded on the individual Browse source records.

prefixes.rationale: The data.gov.ie (Open Data Portal Ireland) mirror in full: 30,252 files, 144.5 GB, across 20,700 packages and 58 publishing organisations. Held locally rather than linked, so catalogue entries that link out to somebody else's server survive that server changing. Published in full at the project owner's explicit direction, 2026-08-31.
prefixes.evidence: Mirrored by scripts/mirror_datagovie.py plus a later reconcile pass; _reconcile_summary.txt records 30,436 expected resources with 74 missing. Measured on disk 2026-08-31: 30,252 files / 144.54 GB. NOTE the mirror's own _manifest.csv is from the FIRST run and describes only 4,947 resources / 3,050 packages -- roughly a sixth. Any figure sourced from that manifest understates this prefix by about six times. Licences harvested per package from CKAN package_show by scripts/harvest-datagovie-licences.mjs --root; per-package detail in gitignored data/external/datagovie-licences.json, rollup at data/database/datagovie-licence-summary.json.
prefixes.rights: Licence is per package. data.gov.ie federates other bodies' data, so each publishing organisation sets the terms for its own datasets, and the files were fetched from publisher hosts rather than from the portal. Per-package licences are harvested from CKAN package_show: rollup at data/database/datagovie-licence-summary.json, per-package detail in gitignored data/external/datagovie-licences.json. Consult the record for a package before reusing its files, and note that packages carrying non-commercial terms are redistributable only for non-commercial purposes.

prefixes.rationale: Holding copy of the data.gov.ie mirror files that the Internet Archive could not accept. IA's ingest queue sat at or over its global cap (total_tasks_queued 12,001 of a 11,999 limit) for over a day, refusing every upload from every user; 95 GB of the corpus is already on IA and this is the 1.23 GB remainder across 19,791 small files. IA remains the destination -- these objects are to be removed once the matching IA items accept them. Publication is safe on the same basis as the IA copies: only packages whose CKAN licence is a recognised open one (CC-BY 4.0, CC-BY-SA 4.0, CC0 1.0) are included, applying the same filter as scripts/upload-tree-ia.mjs.
prefixes.evidence: scripts/plan-datagovie-r2-fallback.mjs builds the manifest and reports its exclusions: 792 files with no recognised open licence and 25 truncated zips are withheld, matching the IA path exactly. Licences harvested per package in data/external/datagovie-licences.json (commit db3b49c5ab). Keys use the IA convention <package>/<file>, so the two stores are directly comparable when reconciling.
prefixes.rights: CC-BY 4.0 / CC-BY-SA 4.0 / CC0 1.0 per package, from the data.gov.ie CKAN licence_id; unrecognised or non-commercial licences are excluded, never guessed

prefixes.rationale: Static word and phrase count shards for the Words in parliament explorer (apps/words/): unigram and bigram uses per chamber, year, party and language, top speakers per term, speakers' distinctive terms and autocomplete lists. Aggregate counts only; no debate text. Added in the same commit as its upload (publish batch 2026-11-03), which goes ahead only with the site owner's approval in chat.
prefixes.evidence: Built by E:/civgraph-parliament/words/tools/build_shards.py from the final speeches/ records (README.md and LEDGER.md there), rebuilt 2026-11-03 without the Stormont Papers sample (tools/exclude_body.py --body stormont; no Stormont rows in meta.json, any series or the speaker index): 15,051 files, 425 MB. Speaker index from official ids (oireachtas:, niassembly:, ukparliament:) and Civgraph person ids only; no TheyWorkForYou member data; crosswalk.csv not published.
prefixes.rights: Oireachtas (Open Data) PSI Licence (Dail, Seanad); Open Parliament Licence v3.0 (Commons 1803-2026, Lords); OGL v3.0 (NI Assembly from 2012-09); NI Assembly 1998-07 to 2012-08 is NI Assembly Commission Parliamentary copyright, counts only, published with the owner's agreement.

prefixes.rationale: Mirror of the Electoral Office for Northern Ireland's published result sheets (Open Government Licence v3.0): the 2022 Assembly, 2023 council and 2024 Westminster sheets now on eoni.org.uk, and the 1973-2021 sheets and booklets the office no longer publishes, copied from Internet Archive captures. Held so the contests that cite them keep a working source. Owner-approved upload of open-licence source mirrors, 11 Nov 2026 (stream ledger).
prefixes.evidence: 413 files, 181.6 MB, one folder per election (<year>-<type>/), each listed in manifest.json with its original eoni.org.uk address, the capture used where the original is gone, bytes, SHA-256 and the election. Result sheets, turnout statistics and statements of rejected ballots only: no nomination papers, agents' notices or addresses.
prefixes.rights: Open Government Licence v3.0 (Electoral Office for Northern Ireland).

prefixes.rationale: Mirror of the Electoral Commission's results spreadsheets that cover Northern Ireland (Westminster, Assembly, European, local and the 2011 and 2016 referendums), Open Government Licence v3.0. Held because the Commission's pages move and its spreadsheets back NI contests on the site. Owner-approved upload of open-licence source mirrors, 11 Nov 2026 (stream ledger).
prefixes.evidence: 30 files, 23.4 MB, one folder per election, each in manifest.json with its source address (direct or Internet Archive capture), bytes and SHA-256. Aggregate results data only.
prefixes.rights: Open Government Licence v3.0 (The Electoral Commission).

prefixes.rationale: Mirror of the Irish Local Electoral Area Boundary Committee reports (2008, 2013, 2018), the Constituency Commission reports (2004, 2007, 2012, 2017), the Electoral Commission's 2023 constituency review and the European constituency reports (2003-2023), with their maps. Irish public sector information re-usable under its open terms. Held so each LEA and Dail constituency map can link its defining report. Owner-approved upload of open-licence source mirrors, 11 Nov 2026 (stream ledger).
prefixes.evidence: 105 files, 751.2 MB, one folder per review (<year>-<lea|constituency|european>/), each in manifest.json with its title, body, publication date, source address (and capture where the host is gone), bytes and SHA-256. Every PDF checked complete (%%EOF). Published reports and maps only; written submissions, which name individuals, were not mirrored.
prefixes.rights: Irish public sector information, open re-use terms (Electoral Commission (Ireland); Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage).

prefixes.rationale: The Civgraph Elections app's static files (site/apps/elections/config.js): v1/extracts/, one Parquet file per body with one row per candidacy (the reviewed columns of scripts/build/elections-app/data.mjs PUBLISHABLE_COLUMNS: election, area, candidate name, person id, party label, outcome, votes, shares and counts), with index.json and manifest.json; and v1/duckdb-wasm-1.29.0/, DuckDB-WASM's WebAssembly and its parquet extension, too big for Pages. Owner-approved upload, 11 Nov 2026, ahead of the app going public (scripts/publish/elections-app-r2-upload.mjs).
prefixes.evidence: Extracts built by npm run build:elections-app from the records build, which D1 civgraph-records already serves at request time: every value is one the records API returns for the same candidacy. npm run check:elections-app-extracts holds them current and publishable (no address, agent, contact or source column; no value that looks like a postcode, Eircode, email, phone number or street address). About 2.3 MB of Parquet for 96 bodies. The WebAssembly files are the npm package @duckdb/duckdb-wasm@1.29.0 and DuckDB's signed v1.1.1 parquet extension, unmodified, each listed with its SHA-256 in src/libs/elections-app-vendor.json.
prefixes.rights: Election results: public records, compiled with their cited sources on the site. DuckDB-WASM and DuckDB: MIT licence (src/libs/elections-app-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt).
prefixes.unlistedReason: The Elections app is not public yet (noindex, unlinked, out of the sitemaps): its files are on R2 for the app to read, but the public data index does not list or name them. The go-public change set (docs/tasks/elections-go-public.patch) clears this flag.
